description: Walter spoken-language revision activated in the 181-recording bank. Replaces repetitive continuation wording with concise teaching language while preserving actor, actual/alternative, immediate/witnessed and acceptance boundaries. Includes all 67 original continuation recordings, related positional-alternative wording, two internal-policy phrases and a stale strong-move description: 81 replacements, 100 unchanged.
